newsitem.title: USA: US crudes falter on technical fallout, grades even.
newsitem.headline: US crudes falter on technical fallout, grades even.

text.p: U.S. crude prices faltered badly Friday afternoon, punctured by technical selling in a fundamentally weak market.
Cash crude business remained stilted heading into the weekend, with many players whipsawed by the events of earlier in the week when differentials came under intense pressure.
Futures market selling pushed May West Texas Intermediate/Cushing 30 cents lower to $19.15-25 a barrel, significantly off high marks set at $19.65-75 earlier.
Only a few trades have moved in the grade sector, notably Light Louisiana Sweet/St. James at a steady 40 cts discount.
